I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel yesterday (Oct 13) at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on #8841 for support.

His message doesn't actually name Marrow Fieldworks. He was answering a question about "Tobias's dealer account" and the Plains depots. I linked that to Marrow Fieldworks because the Central handoff digest says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on Jan 5, 2026. That's an inference, and I said so in the reply.

I also warned her not to mix it up with #4409 and #4412, the older Salina North tickets on that account from before the handoff.

I only used channels Pree is in and files she can see.
